name: sylva
description: Sylva — a local mission control for git worktrees and Claude agents

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
